question: Which of the following calipers is used for marking parallel lines on the inner and outer edges and for locating the centre of a round bar?
solution:
The correct answer is __Leg and point caliper.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Leg and point caliper__ is used for marking parallel lines on the inner and outer edges of a workpiece.
 
• It is also used for locating the centre of a round bar.
 
• This tool typically consists of one pointed leg and another leg with a scribing point.
 
• It is ideal for applications requiring precision marking and layout work.
 
• Leg and point calipers are commonly used in metalworking and woodworking industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spring Joint Caliper:**

 
 
• It is used for measuring and transferring dimensions.
 
• Commonly used in machining for external and internal measurements.
 
 
 
• **Firm Joint Caliper:**
 
 
• Firm joint calipers are used for measuring dimensions but do not have a spring mechanism.
 
• They rely on friction at the joint to hold the measurement in place.
 
 
 
• **Simple Caliper:**
 
 
• Simple calipers are used for basic external and internal measurements.
 
• They do not have additional features for marking or precision work.
